What it is: Rings, amulets, talismans from patrols, events, bosses, travellers, places
A special ingredient (a troll hide, a wyvern scale, a runed hilt)
How it feeds crafting: Used in a recipe with walking materials
Quality rule: At least Rare; about 10% Legendary (to tune)
Blueprint: Needs the base blueprint (type + chosen tier); gives none. Lists 1-3 types it can go into; works at any known tier; replaces one secondary material

What it is: A damaged unique item (a rusted runed blade)
How it feeds crafting: Restored at the forge with walking materials
Quality rule: At least Rare; about 10% Legendary (to tune)
Blueprint: Needs none; restoring costs its type recipe at its tier x1.5 and teaches that blueprint if unknown

How it feeds crafting: Single-use, so generous drops are fine
Broken down into materials and mastery
